about_the_game:
Your voice is your weapon. Your faith is your shield.

Spiritus Sancti is a first-person psychological horror game where every encounter, every battle, and every ritual is performed through your own voice. Equipped with sacred verses, chants, and rites, you’ll speak directly into your microphone to repel, stun, or banish the demonic presence haunting the possessed.

As a young priest sent to verify a suspected possession, you’ll explore a photorealistic, lived-in home transformed into a battlefield between the mortal and the damned. The entity will stalk, taunt, and attack. Reacting to your words, your timing, and even your hesitation.

Your courage and conviction are tested in real time. Mispronounce, falter, or lose focus, and the demon will strike without mercy.

Features:

  • Voice-driven combat & rituals – Use your microphone as your primary tool to interact, defend, and exorcise.

  • Reactive Enemies – The demons listen, learns, and punishes mistakes.

  • Photorealistic atmosphere – Explore a tense, realistic setting that constantly shifts under supernatural influence.

  • Constant tension – No scripted safe zones; danger can come at any time.

Faith is not passive. In Spiritus Sancti, you fight with it.

content_descriptors.notes:
Spiritus Sancti contains scenes of intense horror, violence, and disturbing imagery. Players will encounter graphic depictions of demonic possession, including unsettling transformations, aggressive behavior, and supernatural attacks. Some sequences include blood, injury detail, and gore consistent with violent struggle.

The narrative deals with mature themes such as religious rituals, death, psychological trauma, and the confrontation of malevolent entities.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 x64
  • Processor: Ryzen 2600x, Intel i5 8600k
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1060, AMD RX 580
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 x64
  • Processor: Ryzen 5600x Intel i5-12400F or Better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 2070, RX 5700 XT or Better
  • Storage: 15 GB available space

short_description: Spiritus Sancti is a first-person psychological horror where your voice is your weapon. Speak sacred rites through your microphone to repel, stun, and exorcise the forces of darkness. Every encounter is real-time, every word a test of faith. An experience like no other.
